commercial.heroTitle: Office, Practice and Hotel Cleaning in Vienna
commercial.heroLede: We take on the day-to-day cleaning for offices, medical practices, hotels, restaurants and property managers — reliably, discreetly and built around how you work.
commercial.heroNote: An individual quote, in writing within 24–48 hours.
commercial.sectorsLede: Every sector makes different demands on hygiene, timing and discretion. We learn how your premises run rather than working through a standard package.
commercial.whyLede: What clients in Vienna value about working with us — and why a first job usually turns into a long-term arrangement.
commercial.priceLede: There is no price list for commercial premises, and for good reason: two offices with the same floor area can mean very different amounts of work. We calculate along three factors.
commercial.priceNote: After your enquiry we look at the premises — on site, or from plans and photos — and you normally receive a written, no-obligation quote within 24 to 48 hours.
commercial.ctaText: Tell us which areas are involved and when they need cleaning — we will come back with a concrete quote.

one.title: Office Cleaning
one.body: From a single office to a whole floor: workstations, meeting rooms, kitchens and washrooms are cleaned before or after your business hours so work never stops. Interior glass and consumables can be included on request.
one.cardShort: Workstations, meeting rooms and washrooms, cleaned outside your business hours.
one.cardPhotoAlt: A bright open-plan office with white desks and monitors

points.three: Key and alarm handling by arrangement

two.title: Medical Practice Cleaning
two.body: Medical and dental practices call for a different kind of care than an office. We work to your hygiene plan, keep treatment and waiting areas properly separated, and document the work when you need it for your records.
two.cardShort: Medical and dental practices, cleaned to your own hygiene plan.
two.cardPhotoAlt: A white treatment room with an examination couch and stool

points.two: Treatment and waiting areas kept separate

three.title: Hotel Cleaning
three.body: For hotels, serviced apartments and boarding houses we handle room cleaning, linen changes and the public areas — at short notice too, when occupancy shifts. When you are full we add people rather than move appointments.
three.cardShort: Rooms, linen and public areas — at short notice when you are full.
three.cardPhotoAlt: A freshly made-up hotel room with a double bed

four.title: Restaurant Cleaning
four.body: Dining room, kitchen and washrooms are cleaned before opening or after closing time. We know what food hygiene requires and work so that your kitchen is ready to go when you open.
four.cardShort: Dining room, kitchen and washrooms — before opening or after closing time.
four.cardPhotoAlt: A laid table in a bright restaurant dining room

points.one: Cleaning before opening or after closing

five.title: Property Management
five.body: For property managers and owners' associations we look after stairwells, corridors, laundry and bin rooms and outdoor areas on an agreed schedule. One contact handles every building, so you are not re-coordinating for each address.

one.title: Reliability
one.body: For a business, a missed clean is not a cosmetic issue — it is a problem the next morning. We arrive in the agreed window, including at either end of the day, and tell you ourselves if something comes up. Holidays and sick leave are covered by us, without you having to ask; ideally you never notice the change.

two.title: Quality
two.body: Thoroughness shows in the places you only notice on second glance: skirting boards, door handles, the strip behind the door, the seal around the basin. We work to a fixed checklist per site so the standard does not depend on the day, and we go through that list with you periodically.

three.title: Professionalism
three.body: Our staff are trained, properly employed and background-checked. They move through your premises the way you should move through someone else's: discreetly, without leafing through paperwork, with respect for what is on the desks. Where confidentiality is required — in a medical practice, for instance — we put it in writing.

four.title: Flexibility
four.body: Businesses change: a floor is added, opening hours shift, an event needs one extra visit. We adjust the schedule and the scope rather than insisting on an annual contract, and we invoice what was actually done.

five.title: A Personal Approach
five.body: You have one contact who knows your site — not a hotline and not a rotating cast. That person has been there, knows where the key hangs and which room is occupied on Wednesdays, and is reachable when something has to run differently at short notice.

one.title: Floor area
one.body: Square metres, number of rooms and what is in them. An open-plan office is quicker than the same area split into 20 individual offices with washrooms and a kitchenette.

two.title: Frequency
two.body: Daily, three times a week or once a week. A higher frequency noticeably lowers the effort per visit because less builds up — so the price per clean falls with it.

three.title: Access
three.body: When we can work and how we get in. Cleaning during business hours takes longer than after closing; key handover, alarm systems and lift access all shape the schedule.

pricing.heroLede: We do not work with fixed packages — no two homes are the same. Here is where prices start, what sets the final figure and how you get a firm quote in three steps.
pricing.startLede: Guide figures for private homes, per visit. What you actually pay depends on the factors below — which is why we quote once we know what is involved.
pricing.factorsLede: So you can follow how a quote is put together instead of guessing at it.
pricing.saveText: Booking weekly or fortnightly costs noticeably less per visit than a one-off clean: less builds up, and each visit takes less time. How much it comes to in your case is set out in your quote.
pricing.b2bText: Offices, medical practices, hotels, restaurants and property managers are calculated individually — by floor area, frequency and access, usually after a site visit.
pricing.ctaText: A few details are enough, and you get a quote we hold ourselves to.

one.title: Size
one.body: Square metres, number of rooms and how many bathrooms are involved. This is the single biggest factor.

two.title: Type of clean
two.body: Routine upkeep is a different job from a deep clean or a handover after moving out.

three.title: Frequency
three.body: One-off, weekly or fortnightly. The more regular the visits, the less work each one takes.

four.title: Condition
four.body: How much has built up. After building work or a long gap, the first visit takes longer.

one.q: What is included in a standard cleaning?
one.a: Dusting, vacuuming, mopping, cleaning and sanitising the kitchen and bathroom, and tidying all standard living areas. Deep-cleaning work can be added on request.

two.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
two.a: Not at all. Many clients arrange access and go about their day. We agree how we get in with you beforehand, in person.

three.q: What if I am not satisfied with the cleaning?
three.a: Tell us within 24 hours and we will re-clean the area free of charge. That is what our satisfaction guarantee means.

four.q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
four.a: Yes — we arrive with professional, eco-friendly products and the equipment we need. If you would rather we used your own products, just say so.

five.q: Can I customise my cleaning plan?
five.a: Of course. Extras, focus areas and a recurring schedule can be combined however you like — we work it out together when you enquire.

six.a: You receive an invoice after the visit. We agree the payment method when you enquire, so it suits you.
